mapper.select: SELECT bank_account_id AS account_id, account_pin_hash AS pin_hash, balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND registered_person_id IS NULL FOR UPDATE

SELECT ba.bank_account_id AS account_id, rp.name, ba.bank_code, ba.bank_name, ba.account_number FROM bank_accounts ba JOIN registered_persons rp ON rp.registered_person_id = ba.registered_person_id AND rp.user_id = ba.user_id WHERE ba.user_id = #{userId} AND ba.bank_account_id = #{accountId} AND ba.registered_person_id IS NOT NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transactions ( user_id, bank_account_id, counterparty_bank_account_id, pattern_execution_id, transaction_type, transaction_category, amount, counterparty_name, counterparty_bank_code, counterparty_bank_name, counterparty_account_number, description, balance_after, transaction_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{recipientAccountId}, #{patternExecutionId}, 'TRANSFER_OUT', 'TRANSFER', #{amount}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientBankCode}, #{recipientBankName}, #{recipientAccountNumber}, #{description}, #{balanceAfter}, #{transactionAt} )

INSERT INTO anomaly_events ( user_id, pattern_execution_id, source_bank_account_id, recipient_bank_account_id, recipient_name, recipient_bank_code, recipient_bank_name, recipient_account_number, amount, high_amount_detected, repeated_transfer_detected, recent_transfer_count, risk_level, detected_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{patternExecutionId}, #{sourceAccountId}, #{recipientAccountId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientBankCode}, #{recipientBankName}, #{recipientAccountNumber}, #{amount}, #{highAmountDetected}, #{repeatedTransferDetected}, #{recentTransferCount}, #{riskLevel}, #{detectedAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT anomaly_event_id, pattern_execution_id, source_bank_account_id, recipient_bank_account_id, recipient_name, recipient_bank_code, recipient_bank_name, recipient_account_number, amount, high_amount_detected, repeated_transfer_detected, recent_transfer_count, risk_level, final_action, transaction_id, NULL AS balance_after FROM anomaly_events WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND source_bank_account_id = #{sourceAccountId} AND ((#{patternExecutionId} IS NULL AND pattern_execution_id IS NULL) OR pattern_execution_id = #{patternExecutionId}) AND ((#{recipientAccountId} IS NULL AND recipient_bank_account_id IS NULL) OR recipient_bank_account_id = #{recipientAccountId}) AND recipient_name = #{recipientName} AND recipient_bank_code = #{recipientBankCode} AND recipient_account_number = #{recipientAccountNumber} AND amount = #{amount} AND final_action IS NULL ORDER BY anomaly_event_id DESC LIMIT 1 FOR UPDATE

SELECT ae.anomaly_event_id, ae.pattern_execution_id, ae.source_bank_account_id, ae.recipient_bank_account_id, ae.recipient_name, ae.recipient_bank_code, ae.recipient_bank_name, ae.recipient_account_number, ae.amount, ae.high_amount_detected, ae.repeated_transfer_detected, ae.recent_transfer_count, ae.risk_level, ae.final_action, ae.transaction_id, tx.balance_after FROM anomaly_events ae LEFT JOIN transactions tx ON tx.transaction_id = ae.transaction_id WHERE ae.user_id = #{userId} AND ae.anomaly_event_id = #{anomalyEventId} FOR UPDATE
